claims.summary: Characteristic zero, M>=3, non-integer lambda, P=(x-u)^2Q (Q squarefree, Q(u)uQ(0)!=0). Gamma^(j)_(m,D)=(beta_D/beta_m)[x^m]rem(x^j pi_j(theta)(quo(x^D,P)P),P), pi_j(n)=beta_(n+j)/beta_n. The eps^(M(M-1)+2) coefficient of the rescaled neck window minor det C[:,W_(M-1)] is a nonzero multiple of lambda(lambda-2) t_1^(M-1) t_3 int_0^u (t-u)^3 Q^2 dt, and the eps^(M(M+1)+2) coefficient of det C[:,W_M] a nonzero multiple of lambda(lambda-1)(lambda-2) t_1^(M-1) t_3 int_0^u t(t-u)^3 Q^2 dt; generically val W_(M-1)=M(M-1)+2, val W_M=M(M+1)+2, collinear with W_(M-2) at slope 1, and every Case A set with j>=M-1 exceeds its Laplace bound by 2.
claims.assessment: Working proof: operator form of Gamma^(j), kernel and cokernel of Phi_1 on the stratum, second-order Laplace/adjugate expansion; falsification test at lambda=3/2, M=3,4 on the zero loci of both integrals passed (six exact valuations).
claims.rationale: Proves the confluent top-window conjecture for every M and locates the displaced neck ring; Case B sets on ((M-1)/M,1) remain open.
